profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer | Foster MBA | USMC
profile.summary:
Engineer. Leader. MBA.

I bring 6 years of software engineering experience and 6 years of Marine Corps leadership. I build systems that scale and lead people who deliver. 

Over the last decade I've:
- Shipped consumer-facing and data-intensive software products as an IC, Tech Lead, and PM collaborator
- Led infantry units through high-stakes, complex operations with clarity and decisiveness. Deployed 2x to the Middle East (Syria, Afghanistan)
- Developed business and strategic fluency through an MBA from UW Foster and hands-on product experience

I'm drawn to work where the mission matters and the technical bar is high. 

Former Secret Clearance (Expired). 


TECHNICAL SKILLS:
Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Java
Front End: React, Vue, Svelte, HTML, CSS
Back End: Node.js, Express
Database: PostgreSql, MySql, Mongo, Influx
Analytics: Tableau, Snowflake, Databricks
CI/CD: CircleCI, GitHub Actions
Testing: Playwright, Cypress
Tools: Docker, Grafana, Webpack, AWS (EC2, ECS, S3), NGINX
Collaboration: Git/GitHub, Jira, Confluence,
